I have those. The first time I met one, I was inebriated and stomping around on my lawn. One ran into my foot and sat there looking up at me with his nose all akimbo. He then scurried off to do mole things.

I'd never seen one before and was pretty sure I'd discovered a new species, possibly alien in origin. Alas, it was just a mole. Cute little buggers.

Lol. Nice.

Yeah, I called the neighboring farmers up, completely trashed, and proceeded to rant and rave about the alien creature on my lawn. I only wish this were a joke. I'd lived here for just over a year so it was here in the new house.

It seemed so personable. Like, "What? Get out of my way, human. I have important mole things to do. Mole stuff! Important business, you see. Good day, good day. I'm off to do mole stuff!"

Except I didn't know it was a mole. I wasn't actually sure what the fucker was and that proboscis was just creepy.

By the way, I frequently use anthropomorphism to describe the furry woodland critters. I'm not actually sure what mole stuff is, but it seemed important and it seemed like the mole was indignant at the interruption. But, either way, that's how I first encountered the star nose mole.

Amazingly enough, my fairly new neighbors still liked me.

I imagine the mole having a proper British accent...

You ever think the mole was just calling you a fucking asshole for almost stepping on him in which he also thanks you for not doing so before telling you to have a good day and watch where the fuck you're walking next time?
